name: strava-mcp
description: Requires Strava Premium/Subscriber. Install → agent walks you through your own Strava API app + OAuth → fetch activities, routes, segments, athlete profile (no training analysis). Alternative to Strava’s official subscriber MCP.

STRAVA_CLIENT_ID.title: Strava Client ID
STRAVA_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID from YOUR Strava API application (https://www.strava.com/settings/api). Requires a Strava subscription for Standard Tier API access. There is no shared publisher app.

STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Strava Client Secret
STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client Secret from YOUR Strava API application. Stored in plugin config only — never commit it.
